description_en: Queries the list of intelligent alert events for an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询IPC设备的智能告警事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-device-event --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id zLZyi6aOLyOSHa9hsPyD000000 --event-type 0 --begin-time 1539507310000 --end-time 1539607310000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceEvent

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identity of the device. You can invoke [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identity of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The type of intelligent alerting event:
- Settings for all intelligent alerting events: 0.
- Settings for a specific intelligent alerting event: enter the ordinal number of the intelligent alerting event, such as 10001.

In the IoT Platform console, view all intelligent alerting event types on the **Feature Definition** tab of the **Product Details** page. For more information, see [View intelligent alerting event types](~~207701~~).
parameters.description_zh:
智能告警事件类型：
- 设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
- 设置为单个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，例如：10001。

请在物联网平台控制台，**产品详情**页面的**功能定义**页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考[查看智能告警事件类型](~~207701~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the invocation is failed.</props>

<props="china">
> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
